evidence.quote: To be considered for an interview, please submit a complete application, including a first-year budget using the provided template.

List the strategies and methods you will use to implement your mission and primary goals.
Provide a proposed time line with a progression of dates detailing how you will carry out your mission.
Briefly describe the work you have done to date to research, design, and/or deliver your work's impact.
